meta.title: Increase Event Time: Window stays open and shows error when no radio option is selected and Ok is pressed
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with one invited vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required bidding-time rejection configuration.
Allow buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Open the RFQ Settings action that launches the Increase Event Time window.

args.goal: In the Increase Event Time window, deselect any selected radio option if the UI permits, press Ok with no option selected, and stop with the window still open showing the resulting validation error.

steps.note: Perform the exact no-selection interaction that the domain steps cannot express directly.
Verify that the Increase Event Time window remains open after pressing Ok.
Verify that the application reports an error for submitting without a selected option.
